title: Carried Codex test holder lines: rendered restart wording persisted, stranded lines reach the holder a turn late, and a Stop gives both a carried and a closed line
outcome: The restart marker of a carried Codex test persists its state (ends_by_report, end reported) as data and the line is built at load; a reported end is persisted promptly so a restart words it right; the stranded-carry close at a runtime reset in turn dispatch happens before the prompt's host line is composed, so this prompt tells it; and a turn closing because its runtime stops or exits does not first carry a test it then closes at once.
acceptance: The marker stores data, not a rendered line, and loads old markers with an unknown_line unchanged; a test shows the restart wording after a reported but unsettled end.
A test shows the stranded-carry line in the very prompt whose dispatch reset the runtime.
A Stop with a running Codex test yields one holder line for it.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
